description: This file defines the Option class within the Opencart Admin Controller Event namespace, handling event-driven actions for editing and deleting options, mainly by adding tasks related to products associated with options.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Controller class for handling option-related events in the admin area, specifically for edit and delete operations.

methods.name: editOption
methods.description: Handles the 'after' event for editing an option, adding tasks for each product related to the option.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Handles the 'after' event for deleting an option, adding tasks for each product related to the option.
